verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents its own REST API for automating the my.anydesk console: listing and inspecting clients, retrieving session history, closing sessions, editing comments and aliases, and listing address books. Its CLI separately automates install, licensing, password setup, connection and removal. But the portal UI also manages users, roles and permissions, custom clients, billing and full address-book management, and the documented API covers only a subset of that. missing for 10: API coverage of user/role/permission management, custom client configuration, billing/subscription settings, address-book editing (the API only lists names and IDs), a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and any statement or corroboration of API–UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The **AnyDesk REST API** lets you automate the retrieval and management of account data from the [my.anydesk I](http://my.anydesk.com/login) management console.
List all AnyDesk clients registered to the account; Get details for a specific client (e.g., Alias, online status)
Retrieve Session History for a selected time range ... Close an active session
List the names and IDs of all Address Books associated with your license
The AnyDesk Command-Line Interface (CLI) allows advanced users and IT administrators to automate installation, configuration, connection, and removal tasks.
